attributes.name: Blessing of Zarongel
attributes.powers:
Discard this card to add 1 die to a check.

Discard this card to add 2 dice to a check with the Fire trait, or to a check to defeat or acquire a card with the Animal trait.

Discard this card to explore your location.

"Every beastie has a taste,
Whether raw or stewed to paste!
If a beastie bites your hide,
Climb up top and take a ride!"
-Goblin hunting song

If the top card of the blessings discard pile matches this card, recharge this card instead of discarding it.
